entries.label: 1000000 Opals
cells: A million opals??!? M'lord please, lets be reasonable here! I can give to you but one opal...

entries.label: A Moderate Discount
cells: A... discount? Just a discount? Thats uh, yea, that is certainly doable m'lord. I can grant an additional 15% discount on the next Engineer Schematic creation!

entries.label: Another Try
cells: That sounds like a fair request, what exactly would you like another try at? Choices: Reset Conjuror PTS Invested, All Opals Invested, Jar Collectible Enchantment LVs or All Summoning Doublers.

entries.label: Bring Them Back
cells: I'm sorry, I can't do this... it wouldn't be right. But I can grant 12 hours of respect, to whom should it go? Choices: Bravery, Justice or Wisdom Monument.

entries.label: Infinite Resources
cells: Infinite is more of a concept... instead, I'll grant a 1.25x bonus to Well and Harp resource gain! Oh, and 1.06x for Jar Rupie gain and Fountain Currency value!

entries.label: Knowledge of Future
cells: If I told you what the future was, it wouldn't really be the future anymore would it m'lord? No, you'll have to wait for the future to be the now.

entries.label: More Wishes
cells: Your wish is my command... wait stop no you can't just wish for more wishes!!

entries.label: World 4 Stuff
cells: Uhh, sure, how about these bonuses: +25% Cooking Speed. +10% Shiny Mob LV Up & Breedability Rate. +8% Lab EXP gain

entries.label: World 5 Things
cells: Wow very specific! How about: +15% Sailing Loot Value. +40% Bits gain. +10% Divinity Pts gain

entries.label: World 6 Majigers
cells: Yes yes majigers, how about things like: +20% Next Crop chance. +35% Stealth for Ninja twins. +12% All Essence gain

entries.label: World 7 Watsinames
cells: Hmm... I suspect you're wanting things like +5% total Spelunking Amber, and maybe a little bit for the future skills...? Granted!

entries.label: World 8 Stuff
cells: Oh please, World 8? Is this 'World 8' in the room with us right now? M'lord, you waste both our time!
